remarks:
Discover the perfect blend of natural beauty, privacy, and potential on this 101-acre property in Portland, NY. Mostly wooded and with some trails throughout, this land offers endless opportunities for recreation, hunting, hiking, or building your dream home or retreat. You can see Lake Erie through the trees, but with a bit of clearing the beautiful Lake Erie views would open up from within the property!
A long rough driveway leads into the southern portion of the property. Electric service is already on site, and existing structures include a 16' x 56' carport and a shed, offering immediate utility and storage.
Whether you envision a secluded getaway or simply a beautiful piece of land to explore and enjoy, this property captures the essence of country living with the bonus of lake views and modern convenience. The property is zoned CR: Conservation Residential. See Town of Portland Zoning Ordinance for permitted uses: townofportlandny.gov
